meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可查询 Azure 订阅的配额(服务限制)与用量,算出剩余可用容量,并支持跨区域比较、提交配额调增申请、列出指定区域的配额。实现上优先调用 Azure CLI 的 az quota 命令及内置脚本。
howto.when: 当用户提到“check quotas”“quota exceeded”等英文触发词,或提出“查配额/用量”“申请增加配额”等要求时触发;典型场景是部署前容量验证、区域选择。

say.text: 查一下东部区域的虚拟机 vCPU 配额和用量
say.note: 会返回 limit、usage 和 available

say.text: 把 standardDSv3Family 配额上限申请提高到 500
say.note: 通过 CLI 提交增加申请

howto.what_en: Claude can query Azure quotas and usage, compute available capacity, compare regions, request quota increases, and list quotas for a provider/region, using az quota CLI and bundled scripts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to check quotas, service limits, current usage, request a quota increase, or validate capacity/regional availability (e.g., "check quotas", "quota exceeded").

say_en.text: Check vCPU quota and usage for VMs in East US.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare remaining standardDSv3Family quota in eastus and westus2.
Request a quota increase for standardDSv3Family to 500.
say_en.note: Submits an increase request via CLI.
